headline: Singapore-China firm to invest $6m in Ctg EPZ garment factory
summary: A Singapore-China firm will invest $6 million in a garment factory in the Chittagong Export Processing Zone. The plant is to produce 2.5 million garments a year and create 2,230 jobs, with production targeted for March 2027.
why: Export processing zones attract foreign manufacturing investment into labor-intensive sectors such as garments, which are central to Bangladesh's export earnings.
